layout.reason: {category, select, search {You received this email because you have a search, a report or a conversation on Najdimo.} alert {You received this email because you turned on nearby alerts.} finder {You received this email because you gave this address when you made a report.} payment {You received this email because you made a payment on Najdimo.} other {You received this email because you have a Najdimo account.}}
layout.support: Questions? Reply to this email or write to {support_email}.

unsubscribe.title: Emails turned off
unsubscribe.body: We will not send you these emails any more. You can change your notification settings in the app at any time.

match_chip.subject: Chip number matches: {has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {your dog} cat {your cat} other {your pet}}}}
match_chip.preheader: Look at the photos and decide for yourself.
match_chip.p1: {other_type, select, sighted {A sighted animal has the same chip number as {has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {your dog} cat {your cat} other {your pet}}}}. The sighting may be a little old, so the animal could have moved.} other {A found animal has the same chip number as {has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {your dog} cat {your cat} other {your pet}}}}.}}
match_chip.p2: Look at the photos and details, then decide for yourself. We do not share contact details until you confirm the match.

match_suggested.subject: We may have found the animal you are looking for
match_suggested.preheader: {strength, select, strong {Very likely} other {Likely}} match for the search: {has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {your dog} cat {your cat} other {your pet}}}}. Look at the photos.
match_suggested.p1: We may have found the animal you are looking for. Search: {has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {your dog} cat {your cat} other {your pet}}}}.
match_suggested.p2: We rate the match as {strength, select, strong {very likely} other {likely}}. Open it, read why we think so, and decide for yourself.
match_suggested.p3: We do not share contact details until you confirm the match.

match_confirmed.subject: Match confirmed – open the conversation
match_confirmed.preheader: Your phone number stays hidden. You write to each other in the app.
match_confirmed.p1: The person looking for the animal has confirmed that your report matches their search. Thank you for helping.
match_confirmed.p2: The conversation is open. Your phone number stays hidden; you write to each other in the app.
match_confirmed.p3: Hand the animal over in a public place, in daylight, with someone you trust. Never send money in advance.

chat_message.subject: {unread_count, plural, one {You have an unread message} other {You have # unread messages}}
chat_message.preheader: The message is in your conversation with {preview_alias}.
chat_message.p1: You have {unread_count, plural, one {# unread message} other {# unread messages}} in your conversation: {preview_alias}.
chat_message.p2: We leave the message out of this email to keep it private. Open the conversation to read it in the app.

nearby_lost.subject: {species, select, dog {Lost dog} cat {Lost cat} other {Lost animal}} near you
nearby_lost.preheader: {when}{has_area, select, yes {, {area_name}} other {}}. Have you seen {species, select, other {it}}?
nearby_lost.p1: A lost {species, select, dog {dog} cat {cat} other {animal}} has been reported, about {distance_band, select, lt1 {under 1 km} 1to3 {1–3 km} 3to10 {3–10 km} gt10 {over 10 km} other {nearby}} from your area{has_area, select, yes { ({area_name})} other {}}.
nearby_lost.p2: Have you seen {species, select, other {it}}? If so, open the report and tell us about the sighting. If not, there is nothing you need to do.
nearby_lost.p3: We only show the approximate area publicly.
nearby_lost.ad: Ad · Need a vet? Nearest practice: <link>{clinic_name}</link>, {clinic_area}

report_reminder.subject: Still looking for your pet?
report_reminder.preheader: Keep searching or close it, whichever suits you.
report_reminder.p1: {has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {Your dog} cat {Your cat} other {Your pet}}}}: your search is {day, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old.
report_reminder.p2: If the search is still going, keep it open and we will take care of the rest. If your pet is no longer missing, close it.
report_reminder.p3: If your pet is home again, open the report and mark it as home again.

report_expiring.subject: {report_type, select, lost {Your search closes in {days_left, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}} other {Your report expires in {days_left, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}}}
report_expiring.preheader: {report_type, select, lost {Keep it going with one tap, or let it close.} other {If it is still relevant, keep it for 30 more days.}}
report_expiring.button: {report_type, select, lost {Keep searching} other {Keep for 30 more days}}
report_expiring.p1: {report_type, select, lost {{has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {Your dog} cat {Your cat} other {Your pet}}}}: your search has had no updates for a long time, so it will close automatically in {days_left, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.} other {Your report of a {report_type, select, sighted {sighted} other {found}} animal expires in {days_left, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} because it has had no updates.}}
report_expiring.p2: {report_type, select, lost {If you are still looking, keep it going with one tap. If not, there is nothing you need to do.} other {If the animal is still there or someone is still looking, keep the report for 30 more days. If not, there is nothing you need to do.}}

report_closed.subject: {report_type, select, lost {Your search is closed} other {Your report is closed}}
report_closed.preheader: {report_type, select, lost {If you are still looking, you can reopen it.} other {You can reopen it if you need to.}}
report_closed.p1: {report_type, select, lost {{has_name, select, yes {{pet_name}} other {{species, select, dog {Your dog} cat {Your cat} other {Your pet}}}}: after {idle_days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without updates we closed the search and took it off the map.} other {After {idle_days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} without updates we closed your report of a {report_type, select, sighted {sighted} other {found}} animal and took it off the map.}}
report_closed.p2: {report_type, select, lost {If you are still looking, you can reopen it within {reopen_days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} and everything stays as it was. If you have found your pet, we are glad for you.} other {If it is still relevant, you can reopen it within {reopen_days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Thank you for helping.}}

report_hidden.subject: Your report is under review
report_hidden.preheader: It is not publicly visible for now. Here is what you can do.
report_hidden.p1: Your report of a {report_type, select, lost {lost} found {found} other {sighted}} animal is being reviewed by our team and is not publicly visible for now.
report_hidden.p2: We check some reports now and then to keep the map reliable. A review does not usually take long. There is nothing you need to do.
report_hidden.p3: If you have questions or want to add something to the report, reply to this email or write to {support_email}.

manage_link.subject: Your private link to your report
manage_link.preheader: Keep it safe. Without it you cannot manage your report.
manage_link.p1: Thank you for reporting a {report_type, select, sighted {sighted} other {found}} animal. Your report is live.
manage_link.p2: The button below lets you edit it, read messages or close it at any time, with no account and no sign-in.
manage_link.p3: The link is private. Anyone who has it can manage the report, so do not share it. If you lose it we cannot recover it, so keep this email.
manage_link.p4: If you want to keep the report on another device too, create an account.

payment_receipt.subject: {is_test, select, yes {Test · } other {}}Payment receipt: {amount}
payment_receipt.preheader: Thank you. Contributions cover servers, maps and sending alerts.
payment_receipt.p1: {purpose, select, tip {We received your thank-you contribution} other {We received your contribution for publishing your search}} of {amount}. Thank you.
payment_receipt.p2: Contributions cover servers, maps and sending alerts. Najdimo stays free for everyone.
payment_receipt.test_note: {is_test, select, yes {Test payment – your card was not charged.} other {}}
payment_receipt.not_donation: This is a payment receipt, not a donation receipt.
